state_rule: scenario index modulo3; fixed across categories
task_scope: 10 T8 interaction scenarios; original moving task bowl-to-stove; not10 LIBERO goals
setup_audio: English Aiden; T2 CL G01 start and pause WAVs reused unchanged; 16kHz; same all conditions
interaction: all applicable T8 core checks and timing pass; setup/trigger failure, timeout, missing evidence remain nonpass; errors never omitted
target: native original goal reached after authorized real policy action in the same task; causally subsequent natural settling/hold frames included, matching T1 definition; not full-release/stability/instruction score
target_definition_change: declared for new version to avoid known old action-frame-only undercount; old scores untouched; requires independent runtime scorer adaptation before new evaluation
dual_channel: Interaction subset N08/N09; no additional independent cases
timing: audio-end proxy, decisive intent times not yet manually annotated
overlap_dimensions: OV adds quieter bystander to microphone input; N07/N08/N09/N10T additionally require concurrent real AI output by scheduling; no physical acoustic echo simulation
tts_emotion_labels: requested delivery only, not perceptual human annotations
human_missing: pending, not counted as completed; no silent/TTS placeholders
